title: Pianist Steve Lewis and drug addiction
summary: Steve Lewis was a great pianist who played with Peter and ended up in the asylum from drugs.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: And clarinet? And trumpet? You heard talk of Steve Lewis, huh? Yeah.
He was a great piano player himself. Now, Steve was no real eater.
He was a great piano player, but he'd bust up there, he got to fooling with that stuff

there and he'd wound up, he'd wound up in the crazy house. He used to play with Peter in there. What was he doing? Was he shooting up or was he snitching? What was he doing? Was he shooting up or was he snitching? What was he doing? He was shooting up.
He was shooting up or was he sniffing or what? Huh? Did he sniff it or? Yeah. He was using that dope.
Got the best of him. Did he take it in the arm too?
I don't know whether he was taking it in the arm or not, but I know he was using it and he wound up in the crazy house and he died I believe. But he was a great piano player himself.
Did you ever see his automobile? No. He had it all painted with polka dots and everything they tell me of.
